title: Name reusable steps
summary: Swift: Name reusable steps. Call twice(7).
introduction: A function takes an input and returns a typed result. _ lets callers omit the input label.

blocks.text: Install Swift or use Xcode on a Mac. Save each example as lesson.swift and run swift lesson.swift.

blocks.title: Name reusable steps
blocks.code:
func twice(_ n: Int) -> Int { n * 2 }
print(twice(4))

blocks.text: The underscore removes the external argument label. twice(4) returns 8.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: The returned value must match the declared return type.
